triple-axel.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Hits three times in the same turn.  The second hit has double power, and the third hit has triple power.  Each hit has a separate accuracy check, and this move stops if a hit misses.

Skill Link does not apply.
triple-axel.flavor: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.

triple-dive.flavor: The user performs a perfectly timed triple dive, hitting the target with splashes of water three times in a row.

triple-kick.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Hits three times in the same turn.  The second hit has double power, and the third hit has triple power.  Each hit has a separate accuracy check, and this move stops if a hit misses.

Skill Link does not apply.
triple-kick.flavor: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.

trop-kick.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.
trop-kick.flavor: The user lands an intense kick of tropical origins on the target. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

trump-card.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Power is determined by the PP remaining for this move, after its PP cost is deducted.  Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

PP remaining | Power
------------ | ----:
4 or more    |    40
3            |    50
2            |    60
1            |    80
0            |   200

If this move is activated by another move, the activating move’s PP is used to calculate power.
trump-card.flavor:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

twin-beam.flavor: The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.

twineedle.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Hits twice in the same turn.  Has a chance to poison the target.
twineedle.flavor:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

twinkle-tackle--physical.flavor:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

twinkle-tackle--special.flavor:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

twister.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to make each target flinch.

If the target is under the effect of Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, this move will hit with double power.
twister.flavor: The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at opposing Pokémon. This may also make them flinch.

u-turn.effect:
Inflicts regular damage, then the user immediately switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party.  If the target faints from this attack, the user’s trainer selects the new Pokémon to send out first.  If the user is the last Pokémon in its party that can battle, it will not switch out.

The user may be hit by Pursuit when it switches out, if it has been targeted and Pursuit has not yet been used.

This move may be used even if the user is under the effect of Ingrain.  Ingrain’s effect will end.
u-turn.flavor: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

upper-hand.flavor: The user reacts to the target's movement and strikes with the heel of its palm, making the target flinch. This move fails if the target is not readying a priority move.

uproar.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  User is forced to use this move for 2–5 turns, selected at random.  All Pokémon on the field wake up, and none can fall to sleep until the lock-in ends.

Pokémon cannot use Rest during this effect.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.
uproar.flavor: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.

v-create.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Lowers the user’s Defense, Special Defense, and Speed by one stage each.
v-create.flavor:
With a hot flame on its forehead, the user hurls itself
at its target. This lowers the user’s Defense, Sp. Def,
and Speed stats.

vacuum-wave.flavor: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the target. This move always goes first.

veevee-volley.flavor:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

venom-drench.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by one stage if it is poisoned.
venom-drench.flavor:
Opposing Pokémon are drenched in an odd
poisonous liquid. This lowers the Attack, Sp. Atk, and
Speed stats of a poisoned target.

venoshock.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  If the target is poisoned, this move has double power.
venoshock.flavor: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. This move's power is doubled if the target is poisoned.

vice-grip.flavor: The target is gripped and squeezed from both sides to inflict damage.

victory-dance.flavor: The user performs an intense dance to usher in victory, boosting its Attack, Defense, and Speed stats.

vine-whip.flavor: The target is struck with slender, whiplike vines to inflict damage.

vital-throw.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.
vital-throw.flavor:
The user attacks last. In return, this throw move
never misses.

volt-switch.effect:
Inflicts regular damage, then the user immediately switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party.  If the target faints from this attack, the user’s trainer selects the new Pokémon to send out first.  If the user is the last Pokémon in its party that can battle, it will not switch out.

The user may be hit by Pursuit when it switches out, if it has been targeted and Pursuit has not yet been used.

This move may be used even if the user is under the effect of Ingrain.  Ingrain’s effect will end.
volt-switch.flavor: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

volt-tackle.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil.  Has a chance to paralyze the target.
volt-tackle.flavor:
The user electrifies itself and charges the target.
This also damages the user quite a lot. This attack
may leave the target with paralysis.

wake-up-slap.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  If the target is sleeping, this move has double power, and the target wakes up.
wake-up-slap.flavor:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

water-gun.flavor: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.

water-pledge.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  If a friendly Pokémon used Grass Pledge earlier this turn, all opposing Pokémon have halved Speed for four turns (including this one).
water-pledge.flavor: A column of water hits the target. When used with its fire counterpart, this move's power is boosted and a rainbow appears.

water-pulse.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to confuse the target.
water-pulse.flavor: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. This may also confuse the target.

water-shuriken.flavor: The user hits the target with throwing stars two to five times in a row. This move always goes first.

water-sport.effect: Fire moves inflict half damage, regardless of target.  If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.
water-sport.flavor:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

water-spout.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Power increases with the user’s remaining HP and is given by `150 * HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 150 when the user has full HP.
water-spout.flavor: The user spouts water to damage opposing Pokémon. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.

waterfall.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to make the target flinch.
waterfall.flavor: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch.

wave-crash.flavor: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target with its whole body to inflict damage. This also damages the user quite a lot.

weather-ball.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  If a weather move is active, this move has double power, and its type becomes the type of the weather move.  Shadow Sky is typeless for the purposes of this move.
weather-ball.flavor: This move's type and power change depending on the weather at the time the move is used.

whirlpool.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn.  The user continues to use other moves during this time.  If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times.  Averages to 3 hits per use.

If the target is in the first turn of Dive, this move will hit with double power.
whirlpool.flavor: The user traps the target inside a violent, swirling whirlpool that inflicts damage for four to five turns.

whirlwind.effect:
Switches the target out for another of its trainer’s Pokémon selected at random.  Wild battles end immediately.

Doesn’t affect Pokémon with Suction Cups or under the effect of Ingrain.
whirlwind.flavor: The target is blown away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

wicked-blow.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Always scores a critical hit.
wicked-blow.flavor: The user, having mastered the Dark style, strikes the target with a fierce blow. This move always lands a critical hit.

wide-guard.effect:
Moves with multiple targets will not hit friendly Pokémon for the remainder of this turn.  If the user is last to act this turn, this move will fail.

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.
wide-guard.flavor: The user and its allies are protected from wide-ranging attacks for one turn.

wild-charge.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User takes 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.
wild-charge.flavor: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. This also damages the user a little.

wildbolt-storm.flavor: The user summons a thunderous tempest and savagely attacks with lightning and wind. This may also leave opposing Pokémon with paralysis.

will-o-wisp.flavor: The user shoots a sinister flame at the target to inflict a burn.

wing-attack.flavor: The target is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide to inflict damage.

wish.effect: At the end of the next turn, user will be healed for half its max HP.  If the user is switched out, its replacement will be healed instead for half of the user’s max HP.  If the user faints or is forcefully switched by Roar or Whirlwind, this effect will not activate.
wish.flavor: One turn after this move is used, the user's or its replacement's HP is restored by up to half the user's max HP.

withdraw.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by one stage.
withdraw.flavor: The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, boosting its Defense stat.

wonder-room.effect: For five turns (including this one), every Pokémon’s Defense and Special Defense are swapped.
wonder-room.flavor: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def stats are swapped for five turns.

wood-hammer.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil.
wood-hammer.flavor: The user slams its rugged body into the target to attack. This also damages the user quite a lot.

work-up.effect: Raises the user’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage each.
work-up.flavor: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are boosted.

worry-seed.effect:
Changes the target’s ability to Insomnia.

If the target’s ability is Truant or Multitype, this move will fail.
worry-seed.flavor: A seed that causes worry is planted on the target. It prevents sleep by making the target's Ability Insomnia.

wrap.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn.  The user continues to use other moves during this time.  If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times.  Averages to 3 hits per use.

Rapid Spin cancels this effect.
wrap.flavor: A long body, vines, or the like are used to wrap and squeeze the target for four to five turns.

wring-out.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Power directly relates to the target’s relative remaining HP, given by `1 + 120 * current HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 121.
wring-out.flavor:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

x-scissor.flavor: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes, claws, or the like as if they were a pair of scissors.

yawn.effect:
Puts the target to sleep at the end of the next turn.  Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.  If the target leaves the field, this effect is canceled.  If the target has a status effect when this move is used, this move will fail.

If the target is protected by Safeguard when this move is used, this move will fail.

Insomnia and Vital Spirit prevent the sleep if the target has either at the end of the next turn, but will not cause this move to fail on use.
yawn.flavor: The user lets loose a huge yawn that lulls the target into falling asleep on the next turn.

zap-cannon.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to paralyze the target.
zap-cannon.flavor: The user attacks by firing an electric blast like a cannon. This also leaves the target with paralysis.

zen-headbutt.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to make the target flinch.
zen-headbutt.flavor: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. This may also make the target flinch.

zing-zap.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to make the target flinch.
zing-zap.flavor: The user crashes into the target, delivering a powerful electric shock. This may also make the target flinch.

zippy-zap.flavor:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
